race.comment: SOUTHERN HEIRESS (10) returns and makes her stable debut for the Gollan camp. Her form to kick off last prep reads strongly and if she returns in that vain of form she's the one to beat. Fitted with a 1000m trial here and gets in light with Youngberry's 3kg claim. Bold showing anticipated. STORMLAND (7) is yet to strike since making a switch north but he's going well and the form around him is stacking up. Gets a key switch with Thompson taking over and is drawn favourably. SPIETHTACULAR (9) is another danger after consecutive close seconds here to kick off the campaign. Hitting here straps now and should be pushing forward again to five herself every chance. STREET CHASE (4) is an intriguing runner resuming and makes his stable debut for the Jack Bruce camp. His form is patchy but his peaks are strong. Has been readied with a stylishly trial win to suggest he's come back in great order.
